text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's not a bad result, but first place 
slipped away, didn't it...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what did you think? About my 
race...
choice_data_list: Your training is really paying off!
Your training is really paying off!

There's still plenty of room for 
improvement.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what did you think? About my 
race...
choice_data_list: Your training is really paying off!
Your training is really paying off!

There's still plenty of room for

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, it wasn't my best, but maybe it 
means I'm still growing...?"
choice_data_list:
Yeah, keep this up and you'll win next 
time.
Yeah, at this rate, we can win next time.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Failure is a learning opportunity, you 
say... I see. You're looking at races from 
a bird's-eye perspective.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad you're my Trainer after all. 
Thanks to you, I feel like I can get even 
stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All riiight♪ In honor of your 
achievements, I present you with a clover 
of gratitude and appreciation!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Sharp as ever! As expected of you, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"We're about to go looking for it now~♪ 
You'll come along with me, won't you?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we searched for four-leaf 
clovers together in a park on the way 
back, and she gave me the prettiest one of 
all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I am sure you have noticed far more areas 
for improvement than I myself am aware 
of..."
choice_data_list: Because I'm your trainer, you know.
Because I'm your Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My, how reassuring...! Then by all means, 
would you please share those areas for 
improvement with me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll take any harsh words in stride. Let's 
start the review meeting right away.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's start with how the early stage 
unfolds—

Yeah, first, let's look at how the early 
race unfolds—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, Father was right. It is precisely 
to those who dare admonish us that we owe 
our trust and gratitude...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After muttering softly, Fine Motion 
approached the review session with serious 
eyes.
